title: 光柵耦合器設計
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入光柵相位匹配、方向性與模場重疊；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine grating phase matching, directionality and modal overlap. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。簡化光柵方程只給初始週期；最佳效率需考慮向下輻射、反射、有限孔徑、偏振與實際纖芯模場。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. The simple grating equation only seeds period; efficiency also depends on downward radiation, reflection, aperture, polarization and fiber fields.
